name: wakeflow
description: A disciplined control loop for multi-window Claude Code work: a controller window dispatches scoped task packages across a tmux-resident fleet, collects immutable target results, obtains independent Test validation, reviews the evidence, and decides the next step. Explicit on-disk state roots keep the run auditable; evidence alone does not close a task. Includes state roots, task packages, delivery envelopes, evidence review, and Design/Test intake.
